What is 3DBAE

From 3D file to living product page.

3DBAE brings import, visual finishing, interaction, and publication into one no-code browser workspace, without modifying your source files.

  1. 01 / 04

    Import & optimize

    Bring what you already have.

    12 import formats, 8 export formats, including GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, STL, PLY, SPLAT, SPZ, SOG and more. 3DBAE builds a smaller, faster copy for the web without touching your source. No model yet? Start from a photo.

  2. 02 / 04

    Light & finish

    Make it look like the real thing.

    PBR materials, 106 HDRI environments in up to 4K, path-traced ground shadows, real-time reflections, bloom, and color balance. Add 3D text in 1,942 Google Fonts and shape geometry with 21 modifiers.

  3. 03 / 04

    Build interaction

    Give customers the controls.

    Variants with up to 250 options per set, hotspots with media or Figma frames, Screen UI, typed variables, formulas, and CSV datasets. 20 actions and 15 condition types cover the logic, without a line of code.

  4. 04 / 04

    Publish & embed

    Publish once. Your page, now alive.

    Publish a snapshot that never changes, embed it with one iframe on any site, and let shoppers open it in AR on iPhone or Android at real-world size. Your page and the scene talk through viewer events and a 71-method JavaScript Model API, with AR handoff in 12 languages and team comments on Creator AI and up.

Who it's for

Built for the people who sell, make, and design products.

Different jobs, same starting point: a browser, a model, and a free plan.
